remarks:
Step into one of Buffalo’s most distinctive homes, where craftsmanship and creativity come together in a truly unforgettable setting. This one-of-a-kind property showcases handcrafted woodwork throughout, from the custom exterior details to the warm wood-lined living spaces, decorative built-ins, carved accents, artisan-inspired finishes, and whimsical natural wood elements that make every room feel unique.

Inspired by the owner’s appreciation for natural wood and handcrafted design, this remarkable home offers a rare blend of artistry and function. The first floor features two bedrooms, a spacious living room, dining room, full bath, and an inviting kitchen with custom wood cabinetry, handcrafted shelving, and abundant storage. Upstairs offers two additional bedrooms plus versatile bonus spaces that can be used for storage, a studio, hobby room, home office, or other uses.

Recent improvements include vinyl replacement windows throughout, a newer furnace, central air conditioning, hot water tank and sewer line. Additional features include a private driveway, ceiling fans, washer and dryer, generous built-in storage, and countless handcrafted details that simply cannot be replicated.

Whether you’re an artist, woodworker, collector, or simply someone searching for a home with warmth, personality, and a story to tell, 462 Hewitt offers an opportunity unlike anything else on the market. Conveniently located near shopping, parks, schools, and downtown amenities, this is more than a home—it’s a conversation piece waiting for its next chapter.
